title: Love Divine, All Love Excelling
description: Love Divine, All Love Excelling in Tonic Solfa to LUX EOI, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 2 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1848), as hymn 8, “Love Divine”, where the book credits them to Wesleyan.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Eights and Sevens Double (8.7.8.7 D) (8.7.8.7.8.7.8.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to LUX EOI; any other Eights and Sevens Double (8.7.8.7 D) tune fits them as well.
underlay: Love di-vine, all love ex-cel-ling, Joy of heaven, to earth come down! Fix in us Thy hum-ble dwell-ing, All Thy faith-ful mer-cies crown. Fa-ther! Thou art all com-pas-sion, Pure, un-bound-ed love Thou art; Vis-it us with Thy sal-va-tion, En-ter ev-ery long-ing heart.

lines: Joy of heaven, to earth come down!
Fix in us Thy humble dwelling,
Breathe, O, breathe Thy loving spirit
Let us all in Thee inherit,
Let us find Thy promised rest.
Let us all Thy life receive;

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1848.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848); set to LUX EOI by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
